items.instrument: beam-line BL04B2 of SPring-8 in Japan
items.method: in situ high-energy synchrotron X-ray diffraction (XRD)
items.quote: In situ high-energy synchrotron X-ray diffraction (XRD) was performed in transmission geometry (wave length λ 1⁄40.01093 nm) at the beam-line BL04B2 of SPring-8 in Japan.

items.label: Nd100   xTix (x 1⁄45, 10, 20, 40, 60, 85, 90 and 95 at%)
items.quote: Master alloys of Nd100   xTix (x 1⁄45, 10, 20, 40, 60, 85, 90 and 95 at%) with a mass of about 20 g were prepared from the pure elements 99.98 wt% Ti (HWN titan GmbH), and 99.9 wt% Nd (Goodfellow) in an arc furnace, on a water-cooled copper hearth under a purified Ti-gettered argon atmosphere.
items.starting_materials: pure elements 99.98 wt% Ti (HWN titan GmbH), and 99.9 wt% Nd (Goodfellow)

items.label: Nd20Ti80 and Nd40Ti60
items.quote: For in situ X-ray diffraction (XRD) investigations, alloy ingots of about 2 mm diameter (40 mg) with nominal compositions Nd20Ti80 and Nd40Ti60 were prepared by arc-melting proper quantities of pure Nd and Ti under an argon atmosphere with a Ti getter.
items.synthesis: prepared by arc-melting proper quantities of pure Nd and Ti under an argon atmosphere with a Ti getter
